subject: Scaling ML Pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following what [COMPANY] is doing with conversational
intelligence - building reliable ML on messy, real-world audio is one of
the harder problems in voice AI right now.

One pattern we keep seeing: as model iterations speed up, the bottleneck
shifts to evaluating whether the new version actually sounds better across
edge cases like overlapping speakers or low-confidence transcriptions.
Comparing outputs side by side at scale is a real pain.

That's the core problem we solve at Encord. Leading AI teams such as
Synthesia and Twelve Labs use us to cut audio review cycles and catch
regressions before they ship.

Worth an intro call to see if this maps to what you're running into?

subject: [NAME] - ML Workflows
text:
Hi [NAME],

Exciting to see the OCR and entity extraction focus from [COMPANY].

Working with teams at Reducto, AppFolio, and UiPath, we've seen a
consistent pattern: once document AI is live, the bottleneck shifts from
extraction accuracy to reliably surfacing failures - layout drift, OCR
ambiguity, multilingual edge cases.

Encord's data development platform helps close the loop back into training
and eval without burning engineering cycles.

Would love to hear how your team is thinking about this - would you be open
to connecting sometime next week?

subject: Spoke with Othmane
text:
Hi [NAME] - hope all is well,  

 We previously spoke with Othmane, about Pocket FM's QC bottlenecks as you scale AI-generated content. He highlighted specific needs around long-form coherence, addressing audio hallucinations, and replacing manual tools with more automated workflows.  

 I'm reaching out [SENDER] - we provide an AI data platform that helps teams evaluate generative models and automate quality control for complex multimodal data, including audio.  

 Since then, we've built out quite a bit of dedicated tooling for this exact use case, which is currently helping audio and GenAI teams like Udio and Kyutai scale their evaluation. 

 Is solving these QC bottlenecks something that is relevant for you right now? If so, I'd love to find a few minutes to connect next week.

text:

a surge in demand for Arabic and Hindi and suggested we connect.

Sounds like you needed native speakers in low resource languages (Hindi,
Arabic, amongst others) - we provide that and stand out from other
providers through the automation our annotation tooling provides.

Teams like *Kyutai *got to speed up model retraining cycles using our

Since you're thinking about winning more deals - would you have for a brief
chat next week? Happy to tell you what's worked with other teams,

subject: Is your 3D data pipeline slowing model development?
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've noticed that many of the to ML teams I speak to in the physical AI space find 3D cuboid labeling to be a big bottleneck in their pipeline.

As point cloud datasets grow, drawing cuboids frame by frame turns into a slow, expensive grind and it's hard to scale.

So we're hosting a short, 20-minute masterclass on the 19th of Feb to walk through how teams are moving away from manual-first 3D annotation and into autolabeling workflows, where models generate cuboids and humans focus on review, fixes, and edge cases.

You can save your spot here: [LINK] Or, if you can't make it live, sign up: [LINK] anyway and we'll send you the recording.

subject: Alfonso - chatted with Maria
text:
Hi [NAME] - have been following the [COMPANY] team for some time now &
noticed the planned EU and US expansion of LOLA so thought I'd reach out to
introduce myself.

I lead the voice AI team here at Encord and we've been working with several
frontier AI teams (inc. Kyutai, Udio) and medical teams like Abbvie,
focusing on increasing their clinical annotation throughput and HITL
verification flows to accelerate the fine-tuning of their voice agents -
with traceability needed for 510(k).

If this sounds interesting, would be happy to chat & share what we're
seeing work well for our other partners that require hallucination free,
explainable and clinically correct datasets.

Let me know if you're be open to a 30-minute chat early next week?
